review_kind: independent technical source review; no manuscript acceptance verdict

findings.title: Cached same-path modules bypass executed-byte verification
findings.trigger: A bound module was already loaded into sys.modules under its ordinary name and has the expected __file__, but its executed definitions differ from the currently pinned source bytes.
findings.evidence: load_bound_source hashes the file, then returns the existing module after checking only its path. acquire_fresh_and_prepare likewise checks the native_api file bytes rather than its executed definitions.
findings.impact: A qualification run can execute an unverified cached native adapter or dependency while every current on-disk source pin passes. A clean module-table load takes the verified compile path; the defect is conditional on cached modules.

reproduction.method: Stdlib-only temporary same-path stub; driver and selector imported with python3 -B; no donor numerical module imported.
steps: Create review_stale_bound_stub.py containing VALUE = "verified_current_source" and pin its actual length/hash.
Place a types.ModuleType with the same name and __file__ into sys.modules; set VALUE to "previously_loaded_unverified_code".
Temporarily set driver.HERE to the fixture phase/packet and call driver.load_bound_source(record).
Restore driver.HERE and remove the stub entry; TemporaryDirectory removes the fixture.

findings.action: Before qualified execution, ensure every reused module has trusted evidence of the exact bytes compiled by this loader, or reject unverified cached entries and load a fresh module from verified bytes. Bind native_api to that verified module identity. A minimal preserved successor can implement this without changing selector mathematics.

source_consistent_assessments.topic: Head-only common center and antithetic logits
source_consistent_assessments.assessment: Source-consistent. Only final head.R/global_head.R is varied in the K1 closure; other factors, body parameters and buffers are copied snapshots. The boundary formula is affine in that R slice with identity S and copied B. One common-only safeguard center is shared by every arm. Antithetic offsets therefore preserve common mean logits in exact arithmetic; cast and forward checks remain numerical obligations.

Source-consistent. Original TRAIN residuals and remasked VJP cotangents use the common center. All spans project against the same common gradient, use ordered rank-three bases and the same three pair slots. Topology permutation keeps labels/features fixed; random construction uses its own fixed CPU generator. Failures retain null slots without redraw.

Source-consistent in exact arithmetic. For affine antithetic logits, CE convexity makes the Jensen gap even and nondecreasing along nonnegative radius. The first graph pair supplies positive D0; other pairs use one capped bounded scalar search and explicit tolerance failures. Guards check pooled/member original TRAIN bounds, offset geometry, mean logits and all six class-centered pair differences. Actual FP64 measurement over native-precision logits and feasible tolerances remain unverified.

source_consistent_assessments.topic: Independent coupled-Adam trials and returned custody
source_consistent_assessments.assessment: Source-consistent. Each eligible trial deep-copies the complete K4 prototype and restores original named Adam state, then performs one mean-own-member TRAIN CE update with dropout off and live factors. Each trial restores native RNG and discards its model/optimizer. Returned arms receive selected pre-trial slices, original transported optimizer state and independent copies of native RNG. Frozen-factor transport equivalence is insufficient to qualify these live-factor trials.

Source-consistent. Squirrel acquisition uses 50 fixed-last native updates. Photo acquisition uses all 200 local updates, earliest strict local validation-NLL best model/Adam handoff while retaining post-all200 RNG, then 50 fixed-last global updates. Continuation retains the declared 1950/patience250 or 950 global schedule and epoch0-eligible pooled validation-NLL selector. This review establishes no actual endpoint provenance or runtime correspondence.

Phase-relative descriptors, local dependency preloading and direct compilation of verified bytes are source-consistent for newly loaded modules. The cached-module branch is the confirmed exception described in F1.

known_source_only_limits: The 13 prospective constants and graph-wise interpretation are not frozen; this is an acknowledged source-preparation limit, not a predictive result.

Fresh warm-state provenance, whole-graph identity/affinity and cast behavior, live-factor Adam moments/steps/aliases/buffers/RNG custody, and native continuation correspondence require later qualified numerical checks.
Actual selector cost and trial memory, predictive gain and broader quality comparisons cannot be inferred from this source-only review.
